_meta.purpose: Branded-share (recall) spectrum + category-SEO ownership — for the SEO bucket of the digital-marketing plan deck
_meta.key_insight: RECALL (not price tier) determines how a brand is found. High-recall brands (couture + cult) are name-led; low-recall brands win via category/product SEO. The generic wedding/dress/áo-dài category turf is OWNED by category-SEO players (LAHAVA 15%, MEAN BLVD 28%) — Maison cannot out-SEO them on generic terms, but the specific winnable subset (custom wedding ao dai / vietnamese wedding dress / vietnamese bridal couture) is real demand LAHAVA proves.

owns: vietnam wedding dress shop online international shipping
lahava.com.read: Owns the diaspora wedding-áo-dài category search + international-shipping intent. Proves the wedding-áo-dài category is real demand & winnable via SEO (not all mass red-ocean).

owns: elegant black silk dress with long sleeves
singapore/vietnam clothing stores that ships to us
meanblvd.com.read: Classic product/occasion-descriptor SEO engine — many product pages each catching long-tail.

huongboutique.com.note: 'huong boutique' alone = 65% of organic clicks. Mass RTW but ~90% name-led → cult diaspora recall. Proves recall>tier.

xeoxo.com.note: cheap áo dài but cult-famous → 60% name.

resolution_of_congtri_conflict: NOT a contradiction. (a) 'custom/bespoke/luxury ao dai' EN long-tail = ~0 demand → do NOT chase those exact phrases. (b) Công Trí's /collection folder = 28.6% of traffic because it has MANY well-structured product/collection pages, each named in English after DEMAND-BACKED descriptors (silk gown, poplin dress) — collectively a crawlable browse-engine + the landing set for branded-search visitors. So: product-page SEO works as STRUCTURE (many pages, demand-backed English names), NOT by ranking #1 for a single zero-demand bespoke head-term. Name product pages after terms with demand (silk evening gown, wedding guest dress, modern ao dai), not 'hand-embroidered bespoke ao dai'.

action_split.Matthew_SEO: Embed the winnable specific terms into SEO config + name product/collection pages in English after demand-backed descriptors; ensure branded-search for 'Maison Dénudé' + all diacritic/EN/VN variants resolves to the site with rich info to shorten the decision.
action_split.Maison_brand: Build NAME RECALL (the actual lever) via social/media/PR — currently only FB + IG; expanding channels is Maison's decision. Marketing can suggest, but brand narrative/voice = Maison, not Maddy/Matthew.
action_split.caveat: Suggesting Maison can 'own high-tier keywords' must be checked against data — generic category terms are owned by LAHAVA/MEAN BLVD; Maison's realistic SEO win = brand-name + specific winnable occasion/wedding terms + on-site conversion, NOT generic head-terms.
